title: A Primer of the Pick Haft
summary: Teaches the grip, stance and plain downward spike strike of the war pick to a beginner using body strength alone.

title: Drill-Book of the Spiked Head
summary: Sets daily point drills against a standing post so a beginner learns a straight, sure line for the pick spike.

title: Handbook of the Hammer Face and Beak
summary: Explains when to turn the blunt hammer face or the pointed beak against a target, for students with hardened muscle.

title: Workbook of Pick Footwork
summary: Drills the steps and weight shifts that carry a heavy pick head through a blow, for students with trained tendons.

title: Short Treatise on the Hooked Pull
summary: Teaches the curved beak as a hook for pulling shields, sleeves and legs, using only the strength of a hardened frame.

title: Pick Craft for the Circulating Student
summary: Introduces a student who has circulated qi to the war pick, with light qi carried along the haft into the spike.

title: The Steady Spike Primer
summary: Gives a young circulator five slow drills for placing the pick spike exactly where the eye has chosen.

title: Handbook of Armor-Breaking Basics
summary: Shows a Senior student how a qi-fed pick spike finds the seams and thin spots of plate and mail.

title: A Reader on Haft and Head Balance
summary: Explains how the weight of the head and the length of the haft shape every guard, thrust and recovery.

title: Field Notes on the Soldier's Pick
summary: Collects plain, hard-used pick habits for a Senior student who must fight in a press of armored men.
